## Core {renv} functions

The basic workflow is to initialize a project, check its status, and keep the lockfile up to date. The `installed` column refers to packages in the project library, `recorded` to packages listed in `renv.lock`, and `used` to packages detected in the project files.

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `renv::init()` | Sets up {renv} in a project. It can also restore packages from an existing lockfile. |
| `renv::status()` | Checks whether installed, recorded, and used packages are consistent. It does not change them. |
| `renv::snapshot()` | Updates `renv.lock` to record the packages detected in the project. |
| `renv::restore()` | Installs the packages and versions listed in `renv.lock` into the project library. |
| `renv::update()` | Updates packages in the project library. Run `renv::snapshot()` afterward to record the updated versions. |
| `renv::upgrade()` | Updates {renv} itself. |

In terms of the `status()` columns, installing a package changes `installed`; 

* `snapshot()` and `record()` change `recorded`
* and `restore()` makes `installed` match the packages and versions in `renv.lock`
* `used` reflects what {renv} detects in the project files.

For example, `status()` can show packages that are installed and used but not yet recorded in the lockfile:

::: output-overflow
``` r
renv::status()
#> The following package(s) are in an inconsistent state:
#> 
#>  package           installed recorded used
#>  fontBitstreamVera y         n        y   
#>  fontLiberation    y         n        y   
#>  fontquiver        y         n        y   
#>  gdtools           y         n        y   
#>  ggfun             y         n        y   
#>  ggimage           y         n        y   
#>  ggiraph           y         n        y   
#>  ggplotify         y         n        y   
#>  gridGraphics      y         n        y   
#>  hexbin            y         n        y   
#>  hexSticker        y         n        y   
#>  lattice           y         n        y   
#>  magick            y         n        y   
#>  MASS              y         n        y   
#>  showtext          y         n        y   
#>  showtextdb        y         n        y   
#>  sysfonts          y         n        y   
#>  systemfonts       y         n        y   
#>  yulab.utils       y         n        y   
#> 
#> See `?renv::status` for advice on resolving these issues.
```
:::

Here, the packages are installed (`y`) and detected as used (`y`), but are not recorded in `renv.lock` (`n`). Run `renv::snapshot()` to record the detected dependencies, then check again with `renv::status()`.
